# sonarqube_rules (Data Source)

Lists rules matching a set of filters, e.g. to activate them in a profile with `for_each`. Filters combine with AND; values within one filter with OR. SonarQube returns at most 10000 rules for one search; a broader search fails rather than return a partial list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_rules" "java_bugs" {
  languages  = ["java"]
  types      = ["BUG"]
  severities = ["BLOCKER", "CRITICAL"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_template` (Boolean) Only template rules (true) or only non-template rules (false).
- `languages` (Set of String) Language keys, e.g. `java`.
- `repositories` (Set of String) Rule repository keys, e.g. `java`, `csharpsquid`.
- `search` (String) Free-text search, as in the rules page search box.
- `severities` (Set of String) `INFO`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL` or `BLOCKER`.
- `statuses` (Set of String) `READY`, `BETA`, `DEPRECATED` or `REMOVED`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Rule tags.
- `template_key` (String) Only custom rules created from this template rule.
- `types` (Set of String) `CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY` or `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Matching rules. Sorted by key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Rule key, e.g. `java:S1144`.
- `language` (String) Language key.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `repo` (String) Rule repository.
- `severity` (String) Default severity (`INFO`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL` or `BLOCKER`).
- `status` (String) Rule status (`READY`, `BETA`, `DEPRECATED` or `REMOVED`).
- `type` (String) Rule type (`CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY` or `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`).
